image_description: A crowded scene of sea lions resting on a sandy beach. The primary subject is a large male sea lion in the foreground, facing away from the camera but turning its head slightly to the left. It has a thick neck mane and dark brown fur. Behind it are numerous other sea lions piled together, creating a textured background of bodies.
